input: Write a cold email to the VP of RevOps at Northwind Robotics about our routing tool.
output:
Hi Dana,

Northwind Robotics just posted three RevOps roles in a month, which usually means routing is getting hand-built in spreadsheets faster than anyone can maintain it.

We give teams a routing layer that scores and assigns inbound in seconds, so a rep never sits on a hot lead.

Worth a quick call next Tuesday to see if it fits?

Ray Okafor
